title: Floral Rebirth

outfit_card.silhouette: Ethereal column gown with high-standing fan-like petal wings framing the shoulders, sculpting a blooming silhouette that flows into a softly structured, floor-length skirt.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Filigree silver circlet with dangling crystal beads, paired with sculpted crystal-branch floral horns, miniature blossoms, and an ultra-fine sheer rhinestone veil.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Fitted corseted bodice embellished with crystal beadwork and floral lace, featuring an upright sheer collar, sculpted petal neckline accents, and sheer lace sleeves tapering to delicate wrist cuffs.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Floor-sweeping column skirt draped in shimmering crystalline organza, accented with sculpted petal peplum ridges along the waist, fine iridescent thread embroidery, and matching jewel-encrusted heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Gigantic translucent iridescent petal wings, floating glowing miniature blossom spirits, skeletal floral veins, and suspended crystalline luminescence.
